changelog:
• MySoundLib v1.1.0 Beta 1 release
• Waveform: new green selection color, dedicated SoundQ-style drag & drop button with fade animation and translated hint
• Waveform: dynamic time ruler that adapts from minutes down to milliseconds as you zoom
• Waveform: fixed playhead z-order and drag & drop freezing; dropping into DAWs and folders now works reliably
• Quick Search: taller waveform, fixes and global hotkey no longer stops responding on macOS after idle
• Much faster startup: folder sync no longer re-reads files already in the library and now runs in the background
• macOS: permanent hardware ID licensing, quit-on-close crash fix and Reveal in Finder
• Windows: native API isolation fixes and Reveal in Explorer
• Bug report: fixed 403 block on submission
